title: Harrison Verrett's fall from the advertising truck
summary: Allen and Jones try to recall who was on the advertising wagon the day Harrison Verrett fell, with Dave Williams and a young cornetist, maybe Lastie.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
